description: Defines classes and structures for distributed process group status logging and distributed data parallel (DDP) logging in PyTorch, including ProcessGroupStatus, Logger, C10dLoggingData, and C10dLogger.

classes.name: ProcessGroupStatus
classes.description: Holds the latest status information of a distributed process group, including sequence numbers, work names, and data sizes for enqueued, started, and completed work.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Handles logging of distributed data parallel (DDP) information, including setting data, environment variables, performance stats, and error reporting.

classes.name: C10dLoggingData
classes.description: A generic data structure for logging key-value pairs of strings and integers related to DDP.

classes.name: C10dLogger
classes.description: Abstract base class for logging to a specified destination, with registration and singleton management.

methods.name: set_construction_data_and_log
methods.description: Sets and logs data during DDP construction.

methods.name: log_if_graph_static
methods.description: Logs whether the DDP graph is static.

methods.name: get_bucket_sizes
methods.description: Returns sizes of buckets in bytes.

methods.name: calculate_avg_time
methods.description: Calculates average time using CPU and GPU timers.

methods.name: set_event_time
methods.description: Sets event time based on timer.

methods.name: set_runtime_stats_and_log
methods.description: Collects and logs runtime stats during training.

methods.name: set_error_and_log
methods.description: Logs error information when DDP/reducer fails.
